name: profile
wording: an agent's complete set of values, one for every factor, independent of any harness; a role states a default profile, a persona's profile is its role's with its residue applied, and a harness receives the profile through its binding as a declaration.
reason: The complete value set had no name; the canon called it a vector, which cold-decodes as an embedding (1.64 of 4). Six candidates tied within noise (spec, profile, configuration, manifest, specification, definition); profile is kept because the others name a document or a harness's settings, which in this design are the declaration a binding produces.
